components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Solid digital indigo button with ripple effect.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #4f46e5; color: #fff; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border-radius: 0.75rem; border: none; font-weight: 500; transition: transform 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { box-shadow: 0 4px 14px 0 rgba(79, 70, 229, 0.39); transform: translateY(-1px); }

narrative.overview: Clean and focused with a hint of playfulness, rejecting the dry B2B dashboard look. The system combines modern e-commerce paradigms with bleeding-edge AI interaction models, ensuring the user feels assisted, never overwhelmed. It explicitly rejects cluttered legacy e-commerce grids, boring dry B2B enterprise dashboards, and generic SaaS 'cream/sand' templates.
keyCharacteristics: Vibrant, energetic accents over a clean, neutral canvas.

rules.name: The Intelligent Pop Rule
rules.body: Accents (Violet, Cyan) are reserved for AI-driven moments, gradients, and subtle background meshes. Standard commerce UI relies entirely on Digital Indigo and Neutrals.

rules.name: The Functional Clarity Rule
rules.body: The UI must never feel cramped. Body copy should breathe, and headings must use negative tracking slightly to feel engineered and sharp.

rules.name: The Frosted Glass Rule
rules.body: Critical AI interfaces and floating elements should use glassmorphism (translucency + background blur + slight border) to maintain context of what's underneath while asserting visual hierarchy.

dos: Do use glass and glass-card utilities for floating or AI-related elements.
Do use the background gradient mesh to add depth to the otherwise flat background.
Do rely on generous 1.5rem border radii for major content areas to maintain the soft, tactile feel.
Do ensure focus rings are visible on all interactive elements.
donts: Don't use cluttered, overwhelming legacy e-commerce grids.
Don't build boring, dry B2B enterprise dashboards.
Don't use generic SaaS 'cream/sand' templates or tinted warm-yellow backgrounds; stick to the cool/crisp slate background.
Don't use side-stripe borders (border-left greater than 1px) for alerts or cards.
Don't use identical card grids endlessly; vary the bento layout.
